name: L0 总体审核入口
description: 制作人（L0）总体审核入口，一键发起全面审核，自动收集进度和问题
author: Pipeline-Sys

chapter_ids.description: 章节 ID（逗号分隔，scope=chapter时使用）

auto_trigger_missing.description: 是否自动触发缺失的审查

nodes.name: 参数接收
nodes.expression: ({ audit_id: 'AUDIT-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'') + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(), scope: inputs.audit_scope, started_at: new Date().toISOString(), period: { start: new Date(Date.now() - inputs.period_days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 10), end: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) } })

nodes.name: 扫描待审查项
nodes.description: 扫描所有待审查的任务和文档
nodes.command: echo '=== 扫描待审查项 ===' && echo '--- TaskPacks ---' && find design/ai-native/03_taskpacks -name '*.md' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | wc -l && echo '--- Specs ---' && find design/ai-native/02_specs -name '*.md' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | wc -l && echo '--- Recent Commits ---' && git log --oneline --since='${inputs.period_days} days ago' 2>/dev/null | wc -l && echo '--- Existing Reviews ---' && find workflows/project/logs/reviews -name '*.json' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | wc -l

nodes.name: 解析扫描结果
nodes.expression: (function() { const output = nodes.scan_pending_items.output.stdout || ''; const lines = output.split('\n'); const taskpacks = parseInt(lines.find(l => l.match(/^\d+$/) && lines[lines.indexOf(l) - 1].includes('TaskPacks'))) || 0; const specs = parseInt(lines.find(l => l.match(/^\d+$/) && lines[lines.indexOf(l) - 1].includes('Specs'))) || 0; const commits = parseInt(lines.find(l => l.match(/^\d+$/) && lines[lines.indexOf(l) - 1].includes('Commits'))) || 0; const reviews = parseInt(lines.find(l => l.match(/^\d+$/) && lines[lines.indexOf(l) - 1].includes('Reviews'))) || 0; return { pending: { taskpacks, specs, commits }, existing_reviews: reviews, needs_code_review: commits > reviews, needs_design_review: specs > 0, needs_qa_signoff: taskpacks > 0 }; })()

nodes.name: 检查是否需要触发审查
批量触发审查（占位）
nodes.description: 自动触发缺失的审查流程
nodes.command: echo '自动触发审查已禁用，跳过...' && echo 'code_review_triggered=0' && echo 'design_review_triggered=0'

nodes.name: 收集现有审查记录
nodes.command: mkdir -p workflows/project/logs/reviews && for f in workflows/project/logs/reviews/*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f" && echo '|||'; done | head -50000

nodes.name: 汇总审查数据
nodes.expression: (function() { const output = nodes.collect_existing_reviews.output.stdout || ''; const parts = output.split('|||').filter(p => p.trim()); const reviews = []; parts.forEach(p => { try { const obj = JSON.parse(p.trim()); if (obj && (obj.review_id || obj.signoff_id || obj.acceptance_id)) { reviews.push(obj); } } catch(e) {} }); const crs = reviews.filter(r => r.review_id && r.review_id.startsWith('CR-')); const drs = reviews.filter(r => r.review_id && r.review_id.startsWith('DR-')); const qas = reviews.filter(r => r.signoff_id && r.signoff_id.startsWith('QA-')); return { code_reviews: { count: crs.length, passed: crs.filter(r => r.result === 'APPROVED').length, avg_score: crs.length > 0 ? Math.round(crs.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.score || 0), 0) / crs.length) : 0 }, design_reviews: { count: drs.length, passed: drs.filter(r => r.result === 'APPROVED').length, avg_score: drs.length > 0 ? Math.round(drs.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.score || 0), 0) / drs.length) : 0 }, qa_signoffs: { count: qas.length, passed: qas.filter(r => r.result === 'PASSED' || r.result === 'PARTIAL').length }, all_reviews: reviews }; })()

nodes.name: 收集问题清单
nodes.expression: (function() { const reviews = nodes.aggregate_reviews.output.all_reviews || []; const blockers = []; const warnings = []; const improvements = []; reviews.forEach(r => { if (r.result === 'REJECTED' || r.result === 'FAILED') { blockers.push({ source: r.review_id || r.signoff_id, target: r.task_id || r.doc_path, issues: r.issues || r.blocking_issues || [] }); } else if (r.result === 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' || r.result === 'REVISION_REQUIRED') { warnings.push({ source: r.review_id || r.signoff_id, target: r.task_id || r.doc_path, issues: r.issues || [] }); } if (r.suggestions) { improvements.push(...r.suggestions); } }); return { blockers, warnings, improvements: [...new Set(improvements)], blocker_count: blockers.length, warning_count: warnings.length }; })()

nodes.name: 生成进度报告
nodes.expression: (function() { const agg = nodes.aggregate_reviews.output; const scan = nodes.parse_scan_results.output; const totalReviews = agg.code_reviews.count + agg.design_reviews.count + agg.qa_signoffs.count; const passedReviews = agg.code_reviews.passed + agg.design_reviews.passed + agg.qa_signoffs.passed; const overallRate = totalReviews > 0 ? Math.round((passedReviews / totalReviews) * 100) : 100; return { type: 'progress', audit_id: nodes.intake.output.audit_id, period: nodes.intake.output.period, metrics: { tasks_in_period: scan.pending.taskpacks, specs_in_period: scan.pending.specs, commits_in_period: scan.pending.commits, reviews_completed: totalReviews, reviews_passed: passedReviews, overall_pass_rate: overallRate + '%', code_review_avg_score: agg.code_reviews.avg_score, design_review_avg_score: agg.design_reviews.avg_score }, breakdown: { code_review: agg.code_reviews, design_review: agg.design_reviews, qa_signoff: agg.qa_signoffs }, status: overallRate >= 80 ? 'HEALTHY' : (overallRate >= 60 ? 'WARNING' : 'CRITICAL') }; })()

nodes.name: 生成问题报告
nodes.expression: ({ type: 'issues', audit_id: nodes.intake.output.audit_id, period: nodes.intake.output.period, summary: { blocker_count: nodes.collect_issues.output.blocker_count, warning_count: nodes.collect_issues.output.warning_count, improvement_count: nodes.collect_issues.output.improvements.length }, blockers: nodes.collect_issues.output.blockers, warnings: nodes.collect_issues.output.warnings, improvements: nodes.collect_issues.output.improvements, priority_actions: nodes.collect_issues.output.blocker_count > 0 ? ['优先解决阻塞问题'] : (nodes.collect_issues.output.warning_count > 0 ? ['处理警告问题'] : ['维持现状']) })

nodes.name: 生成决策建议
nodes.expression: (function() { const progress = nodes.generate_progress_report.output; const issues = nodes.generate_issue_report.output; const recommendations = []; if (issues.summary.blocker_count > 0) { recommendations.push('🔴 存在 ' + issues.summary.blocker_count + ' 个阻塞问题，建议暂停新开发，优先修复'); } if (issues.summary.warning_count > 5) { recommendations.push('🟡 警告问题较多（' + issues.summary.warning_count + '个），建议安排专项修复'); } if (progress.metrics.code_review_avg_score < 70) { recommendations.push('⚠️ 代码审查平均分较低（' + progress.metrics.code_review_avg_score + '），建议加强代码规范培训'); } if (progress.status === 'HEALTHY') { recommendations.push('✅ 整体健康，可以继续推进'); } const nextSteps = []; if (issues.summary.blocker_count > 0) { nextSteps.push('修复阻塞问题'); } if (progress.metrics.reviews_completed < progress.metrics.commits_in_period) { nextSteps.push('补充缺失的代码审查'); } nextSteps.push('定期复查进度'); return { decision: progress.status === 'HEALTHY' ? 'PROCEED' : (progress.status === 'WARNING' ? 'PROCEED_WITH_CAUTION' : 'HOLD'), recommendations, next_steps: nextSteps }; })()

nodes.name: 汇总最终报告
nodes.expression: ({ audit_id: nodes.intake.output.audit_id, scope: inputs.audit_scope, requester: inputs.requester, period: nodes.intake.output.period, progress_report: nodes.generate_progress_report.output, issue_report: nodes.generate_issue_report.output, recommendations: nodes.generate_recommendations.output, completed_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 生成进度报告 Markdown
生成问题报告 Markdown
nodes.command:
cat << 'ISSUES_EOF' > "workflows/project/logs/audits/${nodes.intake.output.audit_id}-issues.md"
# 问题报告

> 审核ID: ${nodes.intake.output.audit_id}
> 生成时间: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

## 问题摘要

| 类型 | 数量 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 阻塞问题 | ${nodes.generate_issue_report.output.summary.blocker_count} |
| 🟡 警告问题 | ${nodes.generate_issue_report.output.summary.warning_count} |
| 🟢 改进建议 | ${nodes.generate_issue_report.output.summary.improvement_count} |

## 阻塞问题（Blockers）

${nodes.generate_issue_report.output.summary.blocker_count > 0 ? '需要立即处理：' : '无阻塞问题 ✅'}

## 警告问题（Warnings）

${nodes.generate_issue_report.output.summary.warning_count > 0 ? '建议尽快处理：' : '无警告问题 ✅'}

## 改进建议

$(echo '${nodes.generate_issue_report.output.improvements.slice(0, 10).join("\n")}' | sed 's/^/- /')

## 优先行动

$(echo '${nodes.generate_issue_report.output.priority_actions.join("\n")}' | sed 's/^/1. /')
ISSUES_EOF
